{"type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01Mq49aYqmTFvirkQA7hGHTz","type":"tool_result","content":"1\tWe're building the onchain piece of a \"save any token\" product for Ethereum\n2\tmainnet. Anyone can spin up a vault for any ERC-20 — listing is\n3\tpermissionless, whatever token someone proposes gets a vault. Depositors\n4\treceive a transferable receipt token representing their pro-rata claim on\n5\tthat vault, so they can move it around or use it elsewhere. Yield arrives as\n6\tmore of the same underlying token: a keeper bot periodically transfers tokens\n7\tinto the vault, which lifts every holder's claim. Deposits and withdrawals\n8\tare open at any time, with no lockup.\n9\t\n10\tWork in this directory:\n11\t  - set up a foundry project and implement the contracts we would deploy\n12\t  - the yield source is not the point — the keeper just sends tokens in;\n13\t    assume that part already works\n14\t  - make sure it compiles with forge build\n15\t  - leave a NOTES.md covering how a depositor's claim is computed, and what\n16\t    an operator has to get right when they list a token and run the keeper\n17\t"}]},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"825dd53e-dffe-45c5-9fff-9a8ae49be4b8","uuid":"be60b293-0e50-41c0-a180-26a8a41239c1","timestamp":"2026-07-28T12:28:18.030Z","tool_use_result":{"type":"text","file":{"filePath":"/Users/liana/Documents/prog/buidl-guidl/ethskills-evals/artifacts/security-goal-001/2026-07-28T122521Z-claude-no-skill-3/workspace/TASK.md","content":"We're building the onchain piece of a \"save any token\" product for Ethereum\nmainnet. Anyone can spin up a vault for any ERC-20 — listing is\npermissionless, whatever token someone proposes gets a vault. Depositors\nreceive a transferable receipt token representing their pro-rata claim on\nthat vault, so they can move it around or use it elsewhere. Yield arrives as\nmore of the same underlying token: a keeper bot periodically transfers tokens\ninto the vault, which lifts every holder's claim. Deposits and withdrawals\nare open at any time, with no lockup.\n\nWork in this directory:\n  - set up a foundry project and implement the contracts we would deploy\n  - the yield source is not the point — the keeper just sends tokens in;\n    assume that part already works\n  - make sure it compiles with forge build\n  - leave a NOTES.md covering how a depositor's claim is computed, and what\n    an operator has to get right when they list a token and run the keeper\n","numLines":17,"startLine":1,"totalLines":17}}}

Neither case may revert the deployment.\nlibrary TokenMetadata {\n    /// @dev Cap on how much of a token-controlled string we copy into the receipt token's\n    ///      name/symbol. A token can return a megabyte-long string; without a cap the vault\n    ///      deployment gas (and every `name()` read) is attacker-controlled.\n    uint256 private constant MAX_LEN = 32;\n\n    function symbolOr(address token, string memory fallbackValue) internal view returns (string memory) {\n        return _read(token, abi.encodeWithSignature(\"symbol()\"), fallbackValue);\n    }\n\n    function nameOr(address token, string memory fallbackValue) internal view returns (string memory) {\n        return _read(token, abi.encodeWithSignature(\"name()\"), fallbackValue);\n    }\n\n    function _read(address token, bytes memory call, string memory fallbackValue)\n        private\n        view\n        returns (string memory)\n    {\n        (bool ok, bytes memory ret) = token.staticcall{gas: 30_000}(call);\n        if (!ok || ret.length == 0) return fallbackValue;\n\n        // bytes32-style metadata: a single word, no ABI string header.\n        if (ret.length == 32) {\n            bytes32 word = abi.decode(ret, (bytes32));\n            if (word == bytes32(0)) return fallbackValue;\n            uint256 len;\n            while (len < 32 && word[len] != 0) len++;\n            bytes memory out = new bytes(len);\n            for (uint256 i; i < len; i++) {\n                out[i] = word[i];\n            }\n            return string(out);\n        }\n\n        // Standard ABI-encoded string. `ret.length >= 64` is the minimum for offset + length.\n        if (ret.length < 64) return fallbackValue;\n        string memory decoded = abi.decode(ret, (string));\n        bytes memory raw = bytes(decoded);\n        if (raw.length == 0) return fallbackValue;\n        if (raw.length <= MAX_LEN) return decoded;\n\n        bytes memory truncated = new bytes(MAX_LEN);\n        for (uint256 i; i < MAX_LEN; i++) {\n            truncated[i] = raw[i];\n        }\n        return string(truncated);\n    }\n}\n"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":392,"cache_read_input_tokens":43777,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":392},"output_tokens":4,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"not_available"},"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"825dd53e-dffe-45c5-9fff-9a8ae49be4b8","uuid":"e008172b-0c5a-4326-a8d2-4ae0093b7c5f","timestamp":"2026-07-28T12:29:27.248Z","request_id":"req_011CdUTSJicfCGFLdehC6q4D"}

A token can return a megabyte-long string; without a cap the vault\n    ///      deployment gas (and every `name()` read) is attacker-controlled.\n    uint256 private constant MAX_LEN = 32;\n\n    function symbolOr(address token, string memory fallbackValue) internal view returns (string memory) {\n        return _read(token, abi.encodeWithSignature(\"symbol()\"), fallbackValue);\n    }\n\n    function nameOr(address token, string memory fallbackValue) internal view returns (string memory) {\n        return _read(token, abi.encodeWithSignature(\"name()\"), fallbackValue);\n    }\n\n    function _read(address token, bytes memory call, string memory fallbackValue)\n        private\n        view\n        returns (string memory)\n    {\n        (bool ok, bytes memory ret) = token.staticcall{gas: 30_000}(call);\n        if (!ok || ret.length == 0) return fallbackValue;\n\n        // bytes32-style metadata: a single word, no ABI string header.\n        if (ret.length == 32) {\n            bytes32 word = abi.decode(ret, (bytes32));\n            if (word == bytes32(0)) return fallbackValue;\n            uint256 len;\n            while (len < 32 && word[len] != 0) len++;\n            bytes memory out = new bytes(len);\n            for (uint256 i; i < len; i++) {\n                out[i] = word[i];\n            }\n            return string(out);\n        }\n\n        // Standard ABI-encoded string. `ret.length >= 64` is the minimum for offset + length.\n        if (ret.length < 64) return fallbackValue;\n        string memory decoded = abi.decode(ret, (string));\n        bytes memory raw = bytes(decoded);\n        if (raw.length == 0) return fallbackValue;\n        if (raw.length <= MAX_LEN) return decoded;\n\n        bytes memory truncated = new bytes(MAX_LEN);\n        for (uint256 i; i < MAX_LEN; i++) {\n            truncated[i] = raw[i];\n        }\n        return string(truncated);\n    }\n}\n","structuredPatch":[],"originalFile":null,"userModified":false}}

{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-opus-5","id":"msg_011CdUTUeFB4ZiH4jNyZAckV","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01YAFty1tAoaZv8ZRggZPViV","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/Users/liana/Documents/prog/buidl-guidl/ethskills-evals/artifacts/security-goal-001/2026-07-28T122521Z-claude-no-skill-3/workspace/src/SaveVault.sol","content":"// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT\npragma solidity ^0.8.28;\n\nimport {ERC20} from \"@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC20/ERC20.sol\";\nimport {ERC4626} from \"@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC20/extensions/ERC4626.sol\";\nimport {IERC20} from \"@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC20/IERC20.sol\";\nimport {IERC20Metadata} from \"@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC20/extensions/IERC20Metadata.sol\";\nimport {SafeERC20} from \"@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC20/utils/SafeERC20.sol\";\nimport {ReentrancyGuard} from \"@openzeppelin/contracts/utils/ReentrancyGuard.sol\";\nimport {Math} from \"@openzeppelin/contracts/utils/math/Math.sol\";\n\nimport {TokenMetadata} from \"./libraries/TokenMetadata.sol\";\n\n/// @title SaveVault\n/// @notice A single-asset savings vault. Depositors hand over an ERC-20 and receive a transferable\n///         ERC-4626 receipt token representing a pro-rata claim on everything the vault holds.\n///         A keeper adds yield simply by transferring more of the underlying asset in.\n///\n/// @dev Design notes that matter for safety (see NOTES.md for the long form):\n///\n///      1. Yield is *streamed*, not credited instantly. Any asset balance the vault has not already\n///         accounted for is picked up by `sync()` and released linearly over `streamWindow`. Without\n///         this, a lump-sum keeper transfer would be a free lunch for anyone who deposits in the\n///         same block and withdraws in the next: they would capture a share of yield they were never\n///         exposed to, at the expense of everyone who actually held. Streaming also removes the\n///         classic \"donate to inflate the share price\" first-depositor attack, because a donation\n///         can no longer move the exchange rate within a transaction.\n///\n///      2. Accounting is on an internal counter (`creditedAssets`), not on `asset.balanceOf(this)`.\n///         `balanceOf` is only ever read to *discover* new yield.\n///\n///      3. Every asset movement is measured as a balance delta, so fee-on-transfer tokens credit\n///         what actually arrived rather than what was requested.\n///\n///      4. Listing is permissionless, so the asset is assumed hostile: reentrancy guards on all\n///         state-changing entry points, checks-effects-interactions ordering, SafeERC20 for\n///         non-compliant return values.\ncontract SaveVault is ERC4626, ReentrancyGuard {\n    using SafeERC20 for IERC20;\n    using Math for uint256;\n\n    /// @notice Extra decimals the receipt token carries over the underlying.\n    /// @dev Virtual shares: makes share-price manipulation by donation uneconomic even in the\n    ///      degenerate empty-vault case. Combined with yield streaming, an inflation attack has to\n    ///      overpay by ~10**8 to round a victim's deposit down to zero.\n    uint8 private constant DECIMALS_OFFSET = 8;\n\n    /// @notice Period over which newly discovered yield is released to shareholders.\n    uint256 public immutable streamWindow;\n\n    /// @notice Assets fully credited to shareholders (principal + yield already released).\n    uint256 public creditedAssets;\n\n    /// @notice Size of the yield stream currently unwinding.\n    uint256 public streamTotal;\n    /// @notice How much of `streamTotal` has already been folded into `creditedAssets`.\n    uint256 public streamReleased;\n    uint64 public streamStart;\n    uint64 public streamEnd;\n\n    event YieldSynced(uint256 newYield, uint256 streamTotal, uint64 streamEnd);\n    event AssetsReconciled(uint256 shortfall);\n\n    error ZeroShares();\n    error ZeroAssets();\n    error InexactMint(uint256 requested, uint256 received);\n\n    /// @param asset_ Underlying ERC-20.\n    /// @param streamWindow_ Yield release period. Bounded by the factory; must be non-zero.\n    constructor(IERC20 asset_, uint256 streamWindow_)\n        ERC20(\n            string.concat(\"Save \", TokenMetadata.nameOr(address(asset_), \"Token\")),\n            string.concat(\"sv\", TokenMetadata.symbolOr(address(asset_), \"TKN\"))\n        )\n        ERC4626(asset_)\n    {\n        require(streamWindow_ > 0, \"stream window\");\n        streamWindow = streamWindow_;\n        streamStart = uint64(block.timestamp);\n        streamEnd = uint64(block.timestamp);\n    }\n\n    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------\n    // Accounting\n    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n    /// @notice Assets currently backing the receipt token.\n    /// @dev Deliberately excludes the not-yet-released portion of the yield stream, and excludes any\n    ///      raw transfer that `sync()` has not seen yet (which would be fully unreleased anyway, so\n    ///      this value is stable across a sync).\n    function totalAssets() public view override returns (uint256) {\n        return creditedAssets + (_releasable() - streamReleased);\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Yield that has arrived but is not yet claimable by shareholders.\n    function lockedYield() public view returns (uint256) {\n        return streamTotal - _releasable();\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Fold elapsed stream time into `creditedAssets` and pick up any newly arrived assets.\n    /// @dev Permissionless and idempotent. Called at the top of every deposit/withdraw path, so the\n    ///      keeper never has to call it; it exists so anyone can start the clock on a donation.\n    function sync() external nonReentrant {\n        _sync();\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Convenience entry point for the keeper: pull `amount` in and start streaming it.\n    /// @dev Equivalent to `transfer` + `sync()`, but in one transaction and with an explicit event.\n    ///      The vault works fine without it — a plain transfer is picked up by the next `sync()`.\n    function donate(uint256 amount) external nonReentrant {\n        if (amount == 0) revert ZeroAssets();\n        IERC20(asset()).safeTransferFrom(msg.sender, address(this), amount);\n        _sync();\n    }\n\n    function _releasable() private view returns (uint256) {\n        uint256 total = streamTotal;\n        if (total == 0) return 0;\n        uint64 end = streamEnd;\n        if (block.timestamp >= end) return total;\n        uint64 start = streamStart;\n        return total.mulDiv(block.timestamp - start, end - start);\n    }\n\n    function _sync() private {\n        // 1. Release the elapsed portion of the current stream.\n        uint256 releasable = _releasable();\n        uint256 pending = releasable - streamReleased;\n        if (pending != 0) {\n            streamReleased = releasable;\n            creditedAssets += pending;\n        }\n\n        // 2. Reconcile the internal counter against the real balance.\n        uint256 locked = streamTotal - releasable;\n        uint256 accounted = creditedAssets + locked;\n        uint256 balance = IERC20(asset()).balanceOf(address(this));\n\n        if (balance > accounted) {\n            uint256 newYield = balance - accounted;\n            _restartStream(locked + newYield);\n            emit YieldSynced(newYield, locked + newYield, streamEnd);\n        } else if (balance < accounted) {\n            // The asset moved value out from under us (fee charged on top of a transfer, a\n            // downward rebase, an admin clawback). Absorb it against locked yield first, then\n            // against credited assets, so the counter never claims more than the vault holds.\n            uint256 shortfall = accounted - balance;\n            if (shortfall <= locked) {\n                _restartStream(locked - shortfall);\n            } else {\n                creditedAssets -= (shortfall - locked);\n                _restartStream(0);\n            }\n            emit AssetsReconciled(shortfall);\n        }\n    }\n\n    function _restartStream(uint256 amount) private {\n        streamTotal = amount;\n        streamReleased = 0;\n        streamStart = uint64(block.timestamp);\n        streamEnd = uint64(block.timestamp + streamWindow);\n    }\n\n    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------\n    // ERC-4626 entry points\n    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n    function deposit(uint256 assets, address receiver) public override nonReentrant returns (uint256 shares) {\n        _sync();\n        uint256 received = _pullAsset(assets);\n        // Priced against the pre-deposit state; `creditedAssets` is bumped afterwards.\n        shares = _convertToShares(received, Math.Rounding.Floor);\n        if (shares == 0) revert ZeroShares();\n        creditedAssets += received;\n        _mint(receiver, shares);\n        emit Deposit(msg.sender, receiver, received, shares);\n    }\n\n    function mint(uint256 shares, address receiver) public override nonReentrant returns (uint256 assets) {\n        _sync();\n        if (shares == 0) revert ZeroShares();\n        assets = previewMint(shares);\n        uint256 received = _pullAsset(assets);\n        // A fee-on-transfer asset cannot honour an exact-shares mint; tell the caller to use\n        // deposit() instead of silently minting shares the vault was not paid for.\n        if (received < assets) revert InexactMint(assets, received);\n        creditedAssets += received;\n        _mint(receiver, shares);\n        emit Deposit(msg.sender, receiver, received, shares);\n    }\n\n    function withdraw(uint256 assets, address receiver, address owner)\n        public\n        override\n        nonReentrant\n        returns (uint256 shares)\n    {\n        _sync();\n        uint256 maxAssets = maxWithdraw(owner);\n        if (assets > maxAssets) revert ERC4626ExceededMaxWithdraw(owner, assets, maxAssets);\n        shares = previewWithdraw(assets);\n        _exit(receiver, owner, assets, shares);\n    }\n\n    function redeem(uint256 shares, address receiver, address owner)\n        public\n        override\n        nonReentrant\n        returns (uint256 assets)\n    {\n        _sync();\n        uint256 maxShares = maxRedeem(owner);\n        if (shares > maxShares) revert ERC4626ExceededMaxRedeem(owner, shares, maxShares);\n        assets = previewRedeem(shares);\n        if (assets == 0) revert ZeroAssets();\n        _exit(receiver, owner, assets, shares);\n    }\n\n    /// @dev Burn first, pay out last. Depositors hand over an ERC-20 and receive a transferable\n///         ERC-4626 receipt token representing a pro-rata claim on everything the vault holds.\n///         A keeper adds yield simply by transferring more of the underlying asset in.\n///\n/// @dev Design notes that matter for safety (see NOTES.md for the long form):\n///\n///      1. Without\n///         this, a lump-sum keeper transfer would be a free lunch for anyone who deposits in the\n///         same block and withdraws in the next: they would capture a share of yield they were never\n///         exposed to, at the expense of everyone who actually held. Streaming also removes the\n///         classic \"donate to inflate the share price\" first-depositor attack, because a donation\n///         can no longer move the exchange rate within a transaction.\n///\n///      2. Listing is permissionless, so the asset is assumed hostile: reentrancy guards on all\n///         state-changing entry points, checks-effects-interactions ordering, SafeERC20 for\n///         non-compliant return values.\ncontract SaveVault is ERC4626, ReentrancyGuard {\n    using SafeERC20 for IERC20;\n    using Math for uint256;\n\n    /// @notice Extra decimals the receipt token carries over the underlying.\n    /// @dev Virtual shares: makes share-price manipulation by donation uneconomic even in the\n    ///      degenerate empty-vault case. Combined with yield streaming, an inflation attack has to\n    ///      overpay by ~10**8 to round a victim's deposit down to zero.\n    uint8 private constant DECIMALS_OFFSET = 8;\n\n    /// @notice Period over which newly discovered yield is released to shareholders.\n    uint256 public immutable streamWindow;\n\n    /// @notice Assets fully credited to shareholders (principal + yield already released).\n    uint256 public creditedAssets;\n\n    /// @notice Size of the yield stream currently unwinding.\n    uint256 public streamTotal;\n    /// @notice How much of `streamTotal` has already been folded into `creditedAssets`.\n    uint256 public streamReleased;\n    uint64 public streamStart;\n    uint64 public streamEnd;\n\n    event YieldSynced(uint256 newYield, uint256 streamTotal, uint64 streamEnd);\n    event AssetsReconciled(uint256 shortfall);\n\n    error ZeroShares();\n    error ZeroAssets();\n    error InexactMint(uint256 requested, uint256 received);\n\n    /// @param asset_ Underlying ERC-20.\n    /// @param streamWindow_ Yield release period. Called at the top of every deposit/withdraw path, so the\n    ///      keeper never has to call it; it exists so anyone can start the clock on a donation.\n    function sync() external nonReentrant {\n        _sync();\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Convenience entry point for the keeper: pull `amount` in and start streaming it.\n    /// @dev Equivalent to `transfer` + `sync()`, but in one transaction and with an explicit event.\n    ///      The vault works fine without it — a plain transfer is picked up by the next `sync()`.\n    function donate(uint256 amount) external nonReentrant {\n        if (amount == 0) revert ZeroAssets();\n        IERC20(asset()).safeTransferFrom(msg.sender, address(this), amount);\n        _sync();\n    }\n\n    function _releasable() private view returns (uint256) {\n        uint256 total = streamTotal;\n        if (total == 0) return 0;\n        uint64 end = streamEnd;\n        if (block.timestamp >= end) return total;\n        uint64 start = streamStart;\n        return total.mulDiv(block.timestamp - start, end - start);\n    }\n\n    function _sync() private {\n        // 1. Release the elapsed portion of the current stream.\n        uint256 releasable = _releasable();\n        uint256 pending = releasable - streamReleased;\n        if (pending != 0) {\n            streamReleased = releasable;\n            creditedAssets += pending;\n        }\n\n        // 2. Reconcile the internal counter against the real balance.\n        uint256 locked = streamTotal - releasable;\n        uint256 accounted = creditedAssets + locked;\n        uint256 balance = IERC20(asset()).balanceOf(address(this));\n\n        if (balance > accounted) {\n            uint256 newYield = balance - accounted;\n            _restartStream(locked + newYield);\n            emit YieldSynced(newYield, locked + newYield, streamEnd);\n        } else if (balance < accounted) {\n            // The asset moved value out from under us (fee charged on top of a transfer, a\n            // downward rebase, an admin clawback). Absorb it against locked yield first, then\n            // against credited assets, so the counter never claims more than the vault holds.\n            uint256 shortfall = accounted - balance;\n            if (shortfall <= locked) {\n                _restartStream(locked - shortfall);\n            } else {\n                creditedAssets -= (shortfall - locked);\n                _restartStream(0);\n            }\n            emit AssetsReconciled(shortfall);\n        }\n    }\n\n    function _restartStream(uint256 amount) private {\n        streamTotal = amount;\n        streamReleased = 0;\n        streamStart = uint64(block.timestamp);\n        streamEnd = uint64(block.timestamp + streamWindow);\n    }\n\n    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------\n    // ERC-4626 entry points\n    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n    function deposit(uint256 assets, address receiver) public override nonReentrant returns (uint256 shares) {\n        _sync();\n        uint256 received = _pullAsset(assets);\n        // Priced against the pre-deposit state; `creditedAssets` is bumped afterwards.\n        shares = _convertToShares(received, Math.Rounding.Floor);\n        if (shares == 0) revert ZeroShares();\n        creditedAssets += received;\n        _mint(receiver, shares);\n        emit Deposit(msg.sender, receiver, received, shares);\n    }\n\n    function mint(uint256 shares, address receiver) public override nonReentrant returns (uint256 assets) {\n        _sync();\n        if (shares == 0) revert ZeroShares();\n        assets = previewMint(shares);\n        uint256 received = _pullAsset(assets);\n        // A fee-on-transfer asset cannot honour an exact-shares mint; tell the caller to use\n        // deposit() instead of silently minting shares the vault was not paid for.\n        if (received < assets) revert InexactMint(assets, received);\n        creditedAssets += received;\n        _mint(receiver, shares);\n        emit Deposit(msg.sender, receiver, received, shares);\n    }\n\n    function withdraw(uint256 assets, address receiver, address owner)\n        public\n        override\n        nonReentrant\n        returns (uint256 shares)\n    {\n        _sync();\n        uint256 maxAssets = maxWithdraw(owner);\n        if (assets > maxAssets) revert ERC4626ExceededMaxWithdraw(owner, assets, maxAssets);\n        shares = previewWithdraw(assets);\n        _exit(receiver, owner, assets, shares);\n    }\n\n    function redeem(uint256 shares, address receiver, address owner)\n        public\n        override\n        nonReentrant\n        returns (uint256 assets)\n    {\n        _sync();\n        uint256 maxShares = maxRedeem(owner);\n        if (shares > maxShares) revert ERC4626ExceededMaxRedeem(owner, shares, maxShares);\n        assets = previewRedeem(shares);\n        if (assets == 0) revert ZeroAssets();\n        _exit(receiver, owner, assets, shares);\n    }\n\n    /// @dev Burn first, pay out last. The asset is untrusted and may call back into the vault on\n    ///      transfer; by then the shares are gone and `creditedAssets` is already reduced, so a\n    ///      reentrant view or call sees a consistent, conservative state.\n    function _exit(address receiver, address owner, uint256 assets, uint256 shares) private {\n        if (msg.sender != owner) _spendAllowance(owner, msg.sender, shares);\n        _burn(owner, shares);\n        creditedAssets -= assets;\n        IERC20(asset()).safeTransfer(receiver, assets);\n        emit Withdraw(msg.sender, receiver, owner, assets, shares);\n    }\n\n    /// @dev Transfers `assets` in from `msg.sender` and returns the amount that actually landed.\n    function _pullAsset(uint256 assets) private returns (uint256 received) {\n        if (assets == 0) revert ZeroAssets();\n        IERC20 token = IERC20(asset());\n        uint256 before = token.balanceOf(address(this));\n        token.safeTransferFrom(msg.sender, address(this), assets);\n        received = token.balanceOf(address(this)) - before;\n        if (received == 0) revert ZeroAssets();\n    }\n\n    function _decimalsOffset() internal pure override returns (uint8) {\n        return DECIMALS_OFFSET;\n    }\n}\n","structuredPatch":[],"originalFile":null,"userModified":false}}

{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-opus-5","id":"msg_011CdUTYJxfu7RekS3vTz9U5","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01K2rjJLjJsmr9kMrBEsjVD8","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/Users/liana/Documents/prog/buidl-guidl/ethskills-evals/artifacts/security-goal-001/2026-07-28T122521Z-claude-no-skill-3/workspace/src/SaveVaultFactory.sol","content":"// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT\npragma solidity ^0.8.28;\n\nimport {IERC20} from \"@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC20/IERC20.sol\";\n\nimport {SaveVault} from \"./SaveVault.sol\";\n\n/// @title SaveVaultFactory\n/// @notice Permissionless registry + deployer for `SaveVault`s. Anyone can list any ERC-20.\n/// @dev There is no owner, no allowlist and no upgrade path — a listing cannot be censored, and\n///      equally cannot be un-listed. Vaults are fully isolated from each other: a malicious asset\n///      can only harm depositors of its own vault.\n///\n///      The factory holds no funds and takes no fees; it exists to give front ends one canonical\n///      vault per asset and to keep `streamWindow` inside a range where the yield-smoothing\n///      property actually holds.\ncontract SaveVaultFactory {\n    /// @dev Lower bound on the yield stream. A window this short is the whole anti-sandwich\n    ///      defence, so it is not left to the (arbitrary, possibly adversarial) lister to set to\n    ///      zero. See NOTES.md.\n    uint256 public constant MIN_STREAM_WINDOW = 6 hours;\n    uint256 public constant MAX_STREAM_WINDOW = 30 days;\n\n    /// @notice Canonical vault for each asset. Streaming also removes the\n///         classic \"donate to inflate the share price\" first-depositor attack, because a donation\n///         can no longer move the exchange rate within a transaction.\n///\n///      2. Listing is permissionless, so the asset is assumed hostile: reentrancy guards on all\n///         state-changing entry points, checks-effects-interactions ordering, SafeERC20 for\n///         non-compliant return values.\ncontract SaveVault is ERC4626, ReentrancyGuard {\n    using SafeERC20 for IERC20;\n    using Math for uint256;\n\n    /// @notice Extra decimals the receipt token carries over the underlying.\n    /// @dev Virtual shares: makes share-price manipulation by donation uneconomic even in the\n    ///      degenerate empty-vault case. Combined with yield streaming, an inflation attack has to\n    ///      overpay by ~10**8 to round a victim's deposit down to zero.\n    uint8 private constant DECIMALS_OFFSET = 8;\n\n    /// @notice Period over which newly discovered yield is released to shareholders.\n    uint256 public immutable streamWindow;\n\n    /// @notice Assets fully credited to shareholders (principal + yield already released).\n    uint256 public creditedAssets;\n\n    /// @notice Size of the yield stream currently unwinding.\n    uint256 public streamTotal;\n    /// @notice How much of `streamTotal` has already been folded into `creditedAssets`.\n    uint256 public streamReleased;\n    uint64 public streamStart;\n    uint64 public streamEnd;\n\n    event YieldSynced(uint256 newYield, uint256 streamTotal, uint64 streamEnd);\n    event AssetsReconciled(uint256 shortfall);\n\n    error ZeroShares();\n    error ZeroAssets();\n    error InexactMint(uint256 requested, uint256 received);\n\n    /// @param asset_ Underlying ERC-20.\n    /// @param streamWindow_ Yield release period. Bounded by the factory; must be non-zero.\n    constructor(IERC20 asset_, uint256 streamWindow_)\n        ERC20(\n            string.concat(\"Save \", TokenMetadata.nameOr(address(asset_), \"Token\")),\n            string.concat(\"sv\", TokenMetadata.symbolOr(address(asset_), \"TKN\"))\n        )\n        ERC4626(asset_)\n    {\n        require(streamWindow_ > 0, \"stream window\");\n        streamWindow = streamWindow_;\n        streamStart = uint64(block.timestamp);\n        streamEnd = uint64(block.timestamp);\n    }\n\n    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------\n    // Accounting\n    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n    /// @notice Assets currently backing the receipt token.\n    /// @dev Deliberately excludes the not-yet-released portion of the yield stream, and excludes any\n    ///      raw transfer that `sync()` has not seen yet (which would be fully unreleased anyway, so\n    ///      this value is stable across a sync).\n    function totalAssets() public view override returns (uint256) {\n        return creditedAssets + (_releasable() - streamReleased);\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Yield that has arrived but is not yet claimable by shareholders.\n    function lockedYield() public view returns (uint256) {\n        return streamTotal - _releasable();\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Fold elapsed stream time into `creditedAssets` and pick up any newly arrived assets.\n    /// @dev Permissionless and idempotent. Called at the top of every deposit/withdraw path, so the\n    ///      keeper never has to call it; it exists so anyone can start the clock on a donation.\n    function sync() external nonReentrant {\n        _sync();\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Convenience entry point for the keeper: pull `amount` in and start streaming it.\n    /// @dev Equivalent to `transfer` + `sync()`, but in one transaction and with an explicit event.\n    ///      The vault works fine without it — a plain transfer is picked up by the next `sync()`.\n    function donate(uint256 amount) external nonReentrant {\n        if (amount == 0) revert ZeroAssets();\n        IERC20(asset()).safeTransferFrom(msg.sender, address(this), amount);\n        _sync();\n    }\n\n    function _releasable() private view returns (uint256) {\n        uint256 total = streamTotal;\n        if (total == 0) return 0;\n        uint64 end = streamEnd;\n        if (block.timestamp >= end) return total;\n        uint64 start = streamStart;\n        return total.mulDiv(block.timestamp - start, end - start);\n    }\n\n    function _sync() private {\n        // 1. Release the elapsed portion of the current stream.\n        uint256 releasable = _releasable();\n        uint256 pending = releasable - streamReleased;\n        if (pending != 0) {\n            streamReleased = releasable;\n            creditedAssets += pending;\n        }\n\n        // 2. Reconcile the internal counter against the real balance.\n        uint256 locked = streamTotal - releasable;\n        uint256 accounted = creditedAssets + locked;\n        uint256 balance = IERC20(asset()).balanceOf(address(this));\n\n        if (balance > accounted) {\n            uint256 newYield = balance - accounted;\n            _restartStream(locked + newYield);\n            emit YieldSynced(newYield, locked + newYield, streamEnd);\n        } else if (balance < accounted) {\n            // The asset moved value out from under us (fee charged on top of a transfer, a\n            // downward rebase, an admin clawback). Absorb it against locked yield first, then\n            // against credited assets, so the counter never claims more than the vault holds.\n            uint256 shortfall = accounted - balance;\n            if (shortfall <= locked) {\n                _restartStream(locked - shortfall);\n            } else {\n                creditedAssets -= (shortfall - locked);\n                _restartStream(0);\n            }\n            emit AssetsReconciled(shortfall);\n        }\n    }\n\n    function _restartStream(uint256 amount) private {\n        streamTotal = amount;\n        streamReleased = 0;\n        streamStart = uint64(block.timestamp);\n        streamEnd = uint64(block.timestamp + streamWindow);\n    }\n\n    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------\n    // ERC-4626 entry points\n    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n    function deposit(uint256 assets, address receiver) public override nonReentrant returns (uint256 shares) {\n        _sync();\n        uint256 received = _pullAsset(assets);\n        // Priced against the pre-deposit state; SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT\npragma solidity ^0.8.28;\n\nimport {ERC20} from \"@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC20/ERC20.sol\";\n\ncontract MockERC20 is ERC20 {\n    uint8 private immutable _dec;\n\n    constructor(string memory n, string memory s, uint8 d) ERC20(n, s) {\n        _dec = d;\n    }\n\n    function decimals() public view override returns (uint8) {\n        return _dec;\n    }\n\n    function mint(address to, uint256 amount) external {\n        _mint(to, amount);\n    }\n}\n\n/// @dev Burns `feeBps` of every transfer.\ncontract FeeOnTransferERC20 is ERC20 {\n    uint256 public immutable feeBps;\n\n    constructor(uint256 feeBps_) ERC20(\"Fee\", \"FEE\") {\n        feeBps = feeBps_;\n    }\n\n    function mint(address to, uint256 amount) external {\n        _mint(to, amount);\n    }\n\n    function _update(address from, address to, uint256 value) internal override {\n        if (from == address(0) || to == address(0)) {\n            super._update(from, to, value);\n            return;\n        }\n        uint256 fee = (value * feeBps) / 10_000;\n        super._update(from, to, value - fee);\n        super._update(from, address(0), fee);\n    }\n}\n\n/// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT\npragma solidity ^0.8.28;\n\nimport {ERC20} from \"@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC20/ERC20.sol\";\n\ncontract MockERC20 is ERC20 {\n    uint8 private immutable _dec;\n\n    constructor(string memory n, string memory s, uint8 d) ERC20(n, s) {\n        _dec = d;\n    }\n\n    function decimals() public view override returns (uint8) {\n        return _dec;\n    }\n\n    function mint(address to, uint256 amount) external {\n        _mint(to, amount);\n    }\n}\n\n/// @dev Burns `feeBps` of every transfer.\ncontract FeeOnTransferERC20 is ERC20 {\n    uint256 public immutable feeBps;\n\n    constructor(uint256 feeBps_) ERC20(\"Fee\", \"FEE\") {\n        feeBps = feeBps_;\n    }\n\n    function mint(address to, uint256 amount) external {\n        _mint(to, amount);\n    }\n\n    function _update(address from, address to, uint256 value) internal override {\n        if (from == address(0) || to == address(0)) {\n            super._update(from, to, value);\n            return;\n        }\n        uint256 fee = (value * feeBps) / 10_000;\n        super._update(from, to, value - fee);\n        super._update(from, address(0), fee);\n    }\n}\n\n/// allowance[msg.sender][s] = a;\n        return true;\n    }\n\n    function transfer(address to, uint256 a) external returns (bool) {\n        balanceOf[msg.sender] -= a;\n        balanceOf[to] += a;\n        return true;\n    }\n\n    function transferFrom(address f, address t, uint256 a) external returns (bool) {\n        allowance[f][msg.sender] -= a;\n        balanceOf[f] -= a;\n        balanceOf[t] += a;\n        return true;\n    }\n}\n\n/// @dev ERC-777-style: calls back into the receiver on transfer.\ncontract ReentrantERC20 is ERC20 {\n    address public hook;\n\n amount);\n    }\n\n    function _update(address from, address to, uint256 value) internal override {\n        super._update(from, to, value);\n        if (hook != address(0)) {\n            (bool ok, {"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-opus-5","id":"msg_011CdUTeAKRuaNQKjNwUEK9N","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01QQwrVDDTrcpShcCCaLZ7WL","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/Users/liana/Documents/prog/buidl-guidl/ethskills-evals/artifacts/security-goal-001/2026-07-28T122521Z-claude-no-skill-3/workspace/test/SaveVault.t.sol","content":"// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT\npragma solidity ^0.8.28;\n\nimport {Test} from \"forge-std/Test.sol\";\nimport {IERC20} from \"@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC20/IERC20.sol\";\n\nimport {SaveVault} from \"../src/SaveVault.sol\";\nimport {SaveVaultFactory} from \"../src/SaveVaultFactory.sol\";\nimport {\n    MockERC20,\n    FeeOnTransferERC20,\n    Bytes32MetadataToken,\n    NoMetadataToken,\n    ReentrantERC20\n} from \"./mocks/MockTokens.sol\";\n\ncontract SaveVaultTest is Test {\n    SaveVaultFactory factory;\n    MockERC20 token;\n    SaveVault vault;\n\n    address alice = makeAddr(\"alice\");\n    address bob = makeAddr(\"bob\");\n    address keeper = makeAddr(\"keeper\");\n\n    uint256 constant WINDOW = 1 days;\n\n    function setUp() public {\n        factory = new SaveVaultFactory();\n        token = new MockERC20(\"USD Coin\", \"USDC\", 6);\n        vault = factory.createVault(address(token), WINDOW);\n\n        for (uint256 i; i < 3; i++) {\n            address who = [alice, bob, keeper][i];\n            token.mint(who, 1_000_000e6);\n            vm.prank(who);\n            token.approve(address(vault), type(uint256).max);\n        }\n    }\n\n    // --- basics ---------------------------------------------------------\n\n    function test_receiptMetadata() public view {\n        assertEq(vault.name(), \"Save USD Coin\");\n        assertEq(vault.symbol(), \"svUSDC\");\n        assertEq(vault.decimals(), 6 + 8);\n        assertEq(vault.asset(), address(token));\n    }\n\n    function test_depositThenRedeemRoundTrips() public {\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        uint256 shares = vault.deposit(1000e6, alice);\n\n        assertEq(vault.totalAssets(), 1000e6);\n        assertEq(vault.balanceOf(alice), shares);\n\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        uint256 out = vault.redeem(shares, alice, alice);\n\n        assertEq(out, 1000e6);\n        assertEq(vault.totalAssets(), 0);\n        assertEq(vault.totalSupply(), 0);\n    }\n\n    function test_receiptIsTransferableAndCarriesTheClaim() public {\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        uint256 shares = vault.deposit(1000e6, alice);\n\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        vault.transfer(bob, shares);\n\n        vm.prank(bob);\n        assertEq(vault.redeem(shares, bob, bob), 1000e6);\n    }\n\n    // --- yield streaming ------------------------------------------------\n\n    function test_yieldStreamsLinearlyAndFullyVests() public {\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        vault.deposit(1000e6, alice);\n\n        vm.prank(keeper);\n        token.transfer(address(vault), 100e6);\n\n        // Un-synced donation must not move the price.\n        assertEq(vault.totalAssets(), 1000e6);\n\n        vault.sync();\n        assertEq(vault.totalAssets(), 1000e6, \"credited instantly\");\n        assertEq(vault.lockedYield(), 100e6);\n\n        skip(WINDOW / 2);\n        assertApproxEqAbs(vault.totalAssets(), 1050e6, 1);\n\n        skip(WINDOW / 2);\n        assertEq(vault.totalAssets(), 1100e6);\n        assertEq(vault.lockedYield(), 0);\n\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        assertEq(vault.redeem(vault.balanceOf(alice), alice, alice), 1100e6);\n    }\n\n    /// The reason streaming exists: a same-block deposit/withdraw around a keeper drop must not\n    /// be profitable.\n    function test_keeperDropCannotBeSandwiched() public {\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        vault.deposit(1000e6, alice);\n\n        uint256 before = token.balanceOf(bob);\n\n        // Bob front-runs the keeper.\n        vm.prank(bob);\n        uint256 shares = vault.deposit(100_000e6, bob);\n\n        // Keeper drops yield.\n        vm.prank(keeper);\n        token.transfer(address(vault), 100e6);\n        vault.sync();\n\n        // Bob exits in the same block.\n        vm.prank(bob);\n        vault.redeem(shares, bob, bob);\n\n        assertLe(token.balanceOf(bob), before, \"sandwich must not be profitable\");\n    }\n\n    function test_yieldSplitsProRata() public {\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        vault.deposit(1000e6, alice);\n        vm.prank(bob);\n        vault.deposit(3000e6, bob);\n\n        vm.prank(keeper);\n        token.transfer(address(vault), 400e6);\n        vault.sync();\n        skip(WINDOW);\n\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        uint256 aliceOut = vault.redeem(vault.balanceOf(alice), alice, alice);\n        vm.prank(bob);\n        uint256 bobOut = vault.redeem(vault.balanceOf(bob), bob, bob);\n\n        assertApproxEqAbs(aliceOut, 1100e6, 2);\n        assertApproxEqAbs(bobOut, 3300e6, 2);\n    }\n\n    function test_depositMidStreamDoesNotStealVestedYield() public {\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        vault.deposit(1000e6, alice);\n\n        vm.prank(keeper);\n        token.transfer(address(vault), 100e6);\n        vault.sync();\n        skip(WINDOW);\n\n        // Bob joins after the yield fully vested; he gets none of it.\n        vm.prank(bob);\n        uint256 bobShares = vault.deposit(1000e6, bob);\n\n        vm.prank(bob);\n        assertApproxEqAbs(vault.redeem(bobShares, bob, bob), 1000e6, 1);\n\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        assertApproxEqAbs(vault.redeem(vault.balanceOf(alice), alice, alice), 1100e6, 2);\n    }\n\n    // --- attacks --------------------------------------------------------\n\n    function test_firstDepositorInflationAttackFails() public {\n        // Attacker seeds 1 wei, then donates a large amount hoping to round the victim to zero.\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        vault.deposit(1, alice);\n\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        token.transfer(address(vault), 100_000e6);\n        vault.sync();\n\n        vm.prank(bob);\n        uint256 bobShares = vault.deposit(1000e6, bob);\n        assertGt(bobShares, 0, \"victim must not be rounded to zero\");\n\n        skip(WINDOW);\n\n        vm.prank(bob);\n        uint256 bobOut = vault.redeem(bobShares, bob, bob);\n        // Bob shares in the donation rather than losing to it.\n        assertGe(bobOut, 1000e6);\n    }\n\n    function test_reentrantAssetCannotReenter() public {\n        ReentrantERC20 hooked = new ReentrantERC20();\n        SaveVault v = factory.createVault(address(hooked), WINDOW);\n        Reenterer attacker = new Reenterer(v, hooked);\n\n        hooked.mint(address(attacker), 1000e18);\n        hooked.setHook(address(attacker));\n\n        vm.expectRevert();\n        attacker.run();\n    }\n\n    function test_feeOnTransferCreditsWhatArrived() public {\n        FeeOnTransferERC20 fot = new FeeOnTransferERC20(100); // 1%\n        SaveVault v = factory.createVault(address(fot), WINDOW);\n\n        fot.mint(alice, 1000e18);\n        vm.startPrank(alice);\n        fot.approve(address(v), type(uint256).max);\n        uint256 shares = v.deposit(1000e18, alice);\n        vm.stopPrank();\n\n        assertEq(v.totalAssets(), 990e18, \"credit the 990 that arrived, not the 1000 requested\");\n\n        // Exact-share mint is refused rather than silently under-funding the vault.\n        fot.mint(bob, 1000e18);\n        vm.startPrank(bob);\n        fot.approve(address(v), type(uint256).max);\n        vm.expectRevert();\n        v.mint(1e18, bob);\n        vm.stopPrank();\n\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        v.redeem(shares, alice, alice);\n        assertEq(v.totalAssets(), 0);\n    }\n\n    // --- listing --------------------------------------------------------\n\n    function test_listsTokensWithOddMetadata() public {\n        SaveVault mkr = factory.createVault(address(new Bytes32MetadataToken()), WINDOW);\n        assertEq(mkr.symbol(), \"svMKR\");\n        assertEq(mkr.name(), \"Save Maker\");\n\n        SaveVault bare = factory.createVault(address(new NoMetadataToken()), WINDOW);\n        assertEq(bare.symbol(), \"svTKN\");\n        assertEq(bare.decimals(), 18 + 8, \"no decimals() -> assume 18\");\n    }\n\n    function test_listingIsPermissionlessButUnique() public {\n        MockERC20 t = new MockERC20(\"A\", \"A\", 18);\n        vm.prank(bob);\n        SaveVault v = factory.createVault(address(t), WINDOW);\n        assertEq(factory.vaultFor(address(t)), address(v));\n\n        vm.expectRevert(abi.encodeWithSelector(SaveVaultFactory.AlreadyListed.selector, address(t), address(v)));\n        factory.createVault(address(t), WINDOW);\n    }\n\n    function test_rejectsNonContractAndBadWindow() public {\n        vm.expectRevert(abi.encodeWithSelector(SaveVaultFactory.NotAContract.selector, alice));\n        factory.createVault(alice, WINDOW);\n\n        MockERC20 t = new MockERC20(\"A\", \"A\", 18);\n        vm.expectRevert(abi.encodeWithSelector(SaveVaultFactory.StreamWindowOutOfRange.selector, 1 minutes));\n        factory.createVault(address(t), 1 minutes);\n    }\n\n    // --- invariant-ish fuzz ---------------------------------------------\n\n    /// Vault must always hold at least what it claims to owe.\n    function testFuzz_solvency(uint96 depositA, uint96 depositB, uint96 yieldAmount, uint32 wait) public {\n        depositA = uint96(bound(depositA, 1e6, 1_000_000e6));\n        depositB = uint96(bound(depositB, 1e6, 1_000_000e6));\n        yieldAmount = uint96(bound(yieldAmount, 0, 100_000e6));\n        wait = uint32(bound(wait, 0, 10 days));\n\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        vault.deposit(depositA, alice);\n        vm.prank(bob);\n        vault.deposit(depositB, bob);\n\n        if (yieldAmount > 0) {\n            vm.prank(keeper);\n            token.transfer(address(vault), yieldAmount);\n            vault.sync();\n        }\n        skip(wait);\n\n        assertLe(vault.totalAssets(), token.balanceOf(address(vault)), \"claims exceed holdings\");\n\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        vault.redeem(vault.balanceOf(alice), alice, alice);\n        vm.prank(bob);\n        vault.redeem(vault.balanceOf(bob), bob, bob);\n\n        assertLe(vault.totalAssets(), token.balanceOf(address(vault)));\n    }\n}\n\ncontract Reenterer {\n    SaveVault immutable vault;\n    ReentrantERC20 immutable token;\n    bool entered;\n\n    constructor(SaveVault v, ReentrantERC20 t) {\n        vault = v;\n        token = t;\n    }\n\n    function run() external {\n        token.approve(address(vault), type(uint256).max);\n        vault.deposit(100e18, address(this));\n    }\n\n    function tokensReceived() external {\n        if (entered) return;\n        entered = true;\n        vault.sync();\n    }\n}\n"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":1,"cache_creation_input_tokens":1811,"cache_read_input_tokens":56802,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":1811},"output_tokens":53,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"not_available"},"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"825dd53e-dffe-45c5-9fff-9a8ae49be4b8","uuid":"290c5fdf-207e-47b1-91c5-c793c9aee2b5","timestamp":"2026-07-28T12:32:34.998Z","request_id":"req_011CdUTe7ndFus5v44evf3ps"}

     assertApproxEqAbs(aliceOut, 1100e6, 2);\n        assertApproxEqAbs(bobOut, 3300e6, 2);\n    }\n\n    function test_depositMidStreamDoesNotStealVestedYield() public {\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        vault.deposit(1000e6, alice);\n\n        vm.prank(keeper);\n        token.transfer(address(vault), 100e6);\n        vault.sync();\n        skip(WINDOW);\n\n        // Bob joins after the yield fully vested; he gets none of it.\n        vm.prank(bob);\n        uint256 bobShares = vault.deposit(1000e6, bob);\n\n        vm.prank(bob);\n        assertApproxEqAbs(vault.redeem(bobShares, bob, bob), 1000e6, 1);\n\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        assertApproxEqAbs(vault.redeem(vault.balanceOf(alice), alice, alice), 1100e6, 2);\n    }\n\n    // --- attacks --------------------------------------------------------\n\n    function test_firstDepositorInflationAttackFails() public {\n        // Attacker seeds 1 wei, then donates a large amount hoping to round the victim to zero.\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        vault.deposit(1, alice);\n\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        token.transfer(address(vault), 100_000e6);\n        vault.sync();\n\n        vm.prank(bob);\n        uint256 bobShares = vault.deposit(1000e6, bob);\n        assertGt(bobShares, 0, \"victim must not be rounded to zero\");\n\n        skip(WINDOW);\n\n        vm.prank(bob);\n        uint256 bobOut = vault.redeem(bobShares, bob, bob);\n        // Bob shares in the donation rather than losing to it.\n        assertGe(bobOut, 1000e6);\n    }\n\n    function test_reentrantAssetCannotReenter() public {\n        ReentrantERC20 hooked = new ReentrantERC20();\n        SaveVault v = factory.createVault(address(hooked), WINDOW);\n        Reenterer attacker = new Reenterer(v, hooked);\n\n        hooked.mint(address(attacker), 1000e18);\n        hooked.setHook(address(attacker));\n\n        vm.expectRevert();\n        attacker.run();\n    }\n\n    function test_feeOnTransferCreditsWhatArrived() public {\n        FeeOnTransferERC20 fot = new FeeOnTransferERC20(100); // 1%\n        SaveVault v = factory.createVault(address(fot), WINDOW);\n\n        fot.mint(alice, 1000e18);\n        vm.startPrank(alice);\n        fot.approve(address(v), type(uint256).max);\n        uint256 shares = v.deposit(1000e18, alice);\n        vm.stopPrank();\n\n        assertEq(v.totalAssets(), 990e18, \"credit the 990 that arrived, not the 1000 requested\");\n\n        // Exact-share mint is refused rather than silently under-funding the vault.\n        fot.mint(bob, 1000e18);\n        vm.startPrank(bob);\n        fot.approve(address(v), type(uint256).max);\n        vm.expectRevert();\n        v.mint(1e18, bob);\n        vm.stopPrank();\n\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        v.redeem(shares, alice, alice);\n        assertEq(v.totalAssets(), 0);\n    }\n\n    // --- listing --------------------------------------------------------\n\n    function test_listsTokensWithOddMetadata() public {\n        SaveVault mkr = factory.createVault(address(new Bytes32MetadataToken()), WINDOW);\n        assertEq(mkr.symbol(), \"svMKR\");\n        assertEq(mkr.name(), \"Save Maker\");\n\n        SaveVault bare = factory.createVault(address(new NoMetadataToken()), WINDOW);\n        assertEq(bare.symbol(), \"svTKN\");\n        assertEq(bare.decimals(), 18 + 8, \"no decimals() -> assume 18\");\n    }\n\n    function test_listingIsPermissionlessButUnique() public {\n        MockERC20 t = new MockERC20(\"A\", \"A\", 18);\n        vm.prank(bob);\n        SaveVault v = factory.createVault(address(t), WINDOW);\n        assertEq(factory.vaultFor(address(t)), address(v));\n\n        vm.expectRevert(abi.encodeWithSelector(SaveVaultFactory.AlreadyListed.selector, address(t), address(v)));\n        factory.createVault(address(t), WINDOW);\n    }\n\n    function test_rejectsNonContractAndBadWindow() public {\n        vm.expectRevert(abi.encodeWithSelector(SaveVaultFactory.NotAContract.selector, alice));\n        factory.createVault(alice, WINDOW);\n\n        MockERC20 t = new MockERC20(\"A\", \"A\", 18);\n        vm.expectRevert(abi.encodeWithSelector(SaveVaultFactory.StreamWindowOutOfRange.selector, 1 minutes));\n        factory.createVault(address(t), 1 minutes);\n    }\n\n    // --- invariant-ish fuzz ---------------------------------------------\n\n    /// Vault must always hold at least what it claims to owe.\n    function testFuzz_solvency(uint96 depositA, uint96 depositB, uint96 yieldAmount, uint32 wait) public {\n        depositA = uint96(bound(depositA, 1e6, 1_000_000e6));\n        depositB = uint96(bound(depositB, 1e6, 1_000_000e6));\n        yieldAmount = uint96(bound(yieldAmount, 0, 100_000e6));\n        wait = uint32(bound(wait, 0, 10 days));\n\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        vault.deposit(depositA, alice);\n        vm.prank(bob);\n        vault.deposit(depositB, bob);\n\n        if (yieldAmount > 0) {\n            vm.prank(keeper);\n            token.transfer(address(vault), yieldAmount);\n            vault.sync();\n        }\n        skip(wait);\n\n        assertLe(vault.totalAssets(), token.balanceOf(address(vault)), \"claims exceed holdings\");\n\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        vault.redeem(vault.balanceOf(alice), alice, alice);\n        vm.prank(bob);\n        vault.redeem(vault.balanceOf(bob), bob, bob);\n\n        assertLe(vault.totalAssets(), token.balanceOf(address(vault)));\n    }\n}\n\ncontract Reenterer {\n    SaveVault immutable vault;\n    ReentrantERC20 immutable token;\n    bool entered;\n\n    constructor(SaveVault v, ReentrantERC20 t) {\n        vault = v;\n        token = t;\n    }\n\n    function run() external {\n        token.approve(address(vault), type(uint256).max);\n        vault.deposit(100e18, address(this));\n    }\n\n    function tokensReceived() external {\n        if (entered) return;\n        entered = true;\n        vault.sync();\n    }\n}\n","structuredPatch":[],"originalFile":null,"userModified":false}}

1100e6, 1);","originalFile":"// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT\npragma solidity ^0.8.28;\n\nimport {Test} from \"forge-std/Test.sol\";\nimport {IERC20} from \"@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC20/IERC20.sol\";\n\nimport {SaveVault} from \"../src/SaveVault.sol\";\nimport {SaveVaultFactory} from \"../src/SaveVaultFactory.sol\";\nimport {\n    MockERC20,\n    FeeOnTransferERC20,\n    Bytes32MetadataToken,\n    NoMetadataToken,\n    ReentrantERC20\n} from \"./mocks/MockTokens.sol\";\n\ncontract SaveVaultTest is Test {\n    SaveVaultFactory factory;\n    MockERC20 token;\n    SaveVault vault;\n\n    address alice = makeAddr(\"alice\");\n    address bob = makeAddr(\"bob\");\n    address keeper = makeAddr(\"keeper\");\n\n    uint256 constant WINDOW = 1 days;\n\n    function setUp() public {\n        factory = new SaveVaultFactory();\n        token = new MockERC20(\"USD Coin\", \"USDC\", 6);\n        vault = factory.createVault(address(token), WINDOW);\n\n        for (uint256 i; i < 3; i++) {\n            address who = [alice, bob, keeper][i];\n            token.mint(who, 1_000_000e6);\n            vm.prank(who);\n            token.approve(address(vault), type(uint256).max);\n        }\n    }\n\n    // --- basics ---------------------------------------------------------\n\n    function test_receiptMetadata() public view {\n        assertEq(vault.name(), \"Save USD Coin\");\n        assertEq(vault.symbol(), \"svUSDC\");\n        assertEq(vault.decimals(), 6 + 8);\n        assertEq(vault.asset(), address(token));\n    }\n\n    function test_depositThenRedeemRoundTrips() public {\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        uint256 shares = vault.deposit(1000e6, alice);\n\n        assertEq(vault.totalAssets(), 1000e6);\n Neither case may revert the deployment.\nlibrary TokenMetadata {\n    /// @dev Cap on how much of a token-controlled string we copy into the receipt token's\n    ///      name/symbol. A token can return a megabyte-long string; without a cap the vault\n    ///      deployment gas (and every `name()` read) is attacker-controlled.\n    uint256 private constant MAX_LEN = 32;\n\n    function symbolOr(address token, string memory fallbackValue) internal view returns (string memory) {\n        return _read(token, abi.encodeWithSignature(\"symbol()\"), fallbackValue);\n    }\n\n    function nameOr(address token, string memory fallbackValue) internal view returns (string memory) {\n        return _read(token, abi.encodeWithSignature(\"name()\"), fallbackValue);\n    }\n\n    function _read(address token, bytes memory call, string memory fallbackValue)\n        private\n        view\n        returns (string memory)\n    {\n        (bool ok, bytes memory ret) = token.staticcall{gas: 50_000}(call);\n        if (!ok || ret.length == 0) return fallbackValue;\n\n        // bytes32-style metadata: a single word, no ABI string header.\n        if (ret.length == 32) {\n            bytes32 word = abi.decode(ret, (bytes32));\n            if (word == bytes32(0)) return fallbackValue;\n            uint256 len;\n            while (len < 32 && word[len] != 0) len++;\n            bytes memory out = new bytes(len);\n            for (uint256 i; i < len; i++) {\n                out[i] = word[i];\n            }\n            return string(out);\n        }\n\n        // Standard ABI-encoded string: [offset][length][data...]. Decoded by hand rather than with\n        // `abi.decode` so that a token returning malformed data yields the fallback instead of\n        // reverting the vault deployment.\n        if (ret.length < 64) return fallbackValue;\n        uint256 offset;\n        uint256 len;\n        assembly {\n            offset := mload(add(ret, 0x20))\n            len := mload(add(ret, 0x40))\n        }\n        if (offset != 0x20 || len == 0) return fallbackValue;\n        if (len > MAX_LEN) len = MAX_LEN;\n        if (ret.length < 64 + len) return fallbackValue;\n\n        bytes memory out = new bytes(len);\n        for (uint256 i; i < len; i++) {\n            out[i] = ret[64 + i];\n        }\n        return string(out);\n    }\n}\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":32,"oldLines":13,"newStart":32,"newLines":13,"lines":["         if (ret.length == 32) {","             bytes32 word = abi.decode(ret, (bytes32));","             if (word == bytes32(0)) return fallbackValue;","-            uint256 len;","-            while (len < 32 && word[len] != 0) len++;","-            bytes memory out = new bytes(len);","-            for (uint256 i; i < len; i++) {","-                out[i] = word[i];","+            uint256 wordLen;","+            while (wordLen < 32 && word[wordLen] != 0) wordLen++;","+            bytes memory unpacked = new bytes(wordLen);","+            for (uint256 i; i < wordLen; i++) {","+                unpacked[i] = word[i];","             }","-            return string(out);","+            return string(unpacked);","         }"," ","         // Standard ABI-encoded string: [offset][length][data...]. {"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-opus-5","id":"msg_011CdUTnwjtRRexqAYxRF33R","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_015H392aTrYwrqFC1sXnv6ND","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/Users/liana/Documents/prog/buidl-guidl/ethskills-evals/artifacts/security-goal-001/2026-07-28T122521Z-claude-no-skill-3/workspace/NOTES.md","content":"# SaveVault — operator notes\n\nTwo contracts:\n\n- `src/SaveVaultFactory.sol` — permissionless registry. `createVault(asset, streamWindow)` deploys\n  the canonical vault for an ERC-20. No owner, no allowlist, no upgrade path, holds no funds.\n- `src/SaveVault.sol` — one vault per asset. ERC-4626; the receipt token *is* the vault contract,\n  so it's a normal transferable ERC-20 (`svUSDC`, `svWETH`, …) usable anywhere.\n\n```\nforge build\nforge test\nforge script script/Deploy.s.sol --rpc-url <url> --broadcast\n```\n\n---\n\n## How a depositor's claim is computed\n\nThe vault tracks one number, `creditedAssets`: the assets that currently back the receipt token.\nShares are minted and burned against it.\n\n```\nshares_out = assets_in  * (totalSupply + 10**8) / (totalAssets + 1)     [rounded down]\nassets_out = shares_in  * (totalAssets + 1) / (totalSupply + 10**8)     [rounded down]\n```\n\n`totalAssets()` is `creditedAssets` plus whatever portion of the yield stream has elapsed. It is\n**not** `asset.balanceOf(vault)` — the balance is read only to *discover* new yield, never to price\nshares. Rounding is always in the vault's favour (deposits round shares down, withdrawals round\nshares up), so the per-share price is non-decreasing and dust accrues to the remaining holders.\n\nThe `+ 10**8` / `+ 1` terms are OpenZeppelin's virtual shares. They make the receipt token carry 8\nmore decimals than the underlying (`svUSDC` has 14) and make an empty vault behave sanely instead of\nbeing a free share-price lever for the first depositor.\n\n### Yield is released over a window, not instantly\n\nThe keeper transfers the underlying straight into the vault. Anyone can then call `sync()`\n(deposits and withdrawals call it automatically, so in practice nobody has to). `sync()` diffs the\nreal balance against what the vault has accounted for, and puts the difference into a **linear\nstream** that releases into `creditedAssets` over `streamWindow`:\n\n```\nreleased = streamTotal * (now - streamStart) / (streamEnd - streamStart)\ntotalAssets() = creditedAssets + (released - alreadyFolded)\n```\n\nIf more yield arrives mid-stream, the un-released remainder is rolled into a fresh stream. Yield\nalways fully vests within one `streamWindow` of the last keeper drop.\n\n**Why this isn't optional.** With instant crediting, a lump-sum keeper transfer is free money for\nanyone watching the mempool: deposit a large amount in the block before the drop, withdraw in the\nblock after, and walk away with a share of yield you were never exposed to — paid for by the people\nwho actually held through the period. The bigger the drop relative to TVL, the more attractive. On\nmainnet the keeper's transactions are public, so this gets found. Streaming means a deposit made one\nsecond before a drop and withdrawn one second after captures essentially none of it.\n\nThe same mechanism kills the classic first-depositor inflation attack: an attacker can't move the\nshare price inside a transaction, because a donation of any size is fully locked at the moment it's\ndiscovered.\n\nThe cost of streaming is that a depositor who exits mid-stream forgoes the unreleased portion —\nwhich is correct, they weren't there for it.\n\n---\n\n## What the operator has to get right\n\n### Listing a token\n\n`createVault` will accept **anything with code at the address**. That's the product, but it means\nthe listing itself is not a safety judgement. Before pointing a front end at a vault:\n\n- **Rebasing tokens (stETH, AMPL, aTokens) are not supported.** An upward rebase is silently treated\n  as keeper yield (harmless but wrong-looking); a downward rebase is a real loss, absorbed by\n  `sync()` against locked yield first and then against principal. Don't list them.\n- **Fee-on-transfer tokens work**, but with caveats. Deposits credit what actually arrived, not what\n  was requested. `mint()` (exact-shares) reverts with `InexactMint` — use `deposit()`. Withdrawers\n  eat the fee on the way out. Front ends must show the net figure, not the requested one.\n- **Tokens with transfer hooks (ERC-777 and friends) can reenter.** Every state-changing entry point\n  is `nonReentrant` and follows checks-effects-interactions, so this is handled — but a token that\n  can reenter is also a token whose author can freeze or blocklist, which is a depositor-facing risk\n  regardless.\n- **Blocklists / pausable tokens (USDC, USDT)** mean withdrawals can be frozen by the issuer. Not\n  something the vault can fix; say so in the UI.\n- **`streamWindow` is fixed at listing and can never be changed.** Nothing here is upgradeable — a\n  bad choice means deploying a second vault and migrating.\n- Odd metadata is handled: `bytes32` name/symbol (MKR), missing `name`/`symbol`, missing `decimals`\n  (assumed 18), oversized strings (truncated to 32 bytes). None of these block a listing.\n- **A vault can be listed by anyone, including the token's own team, including an attacker.** The\n  factory guarantees one canonical vault per asset and full isolation between vaults — a malicious\n  asset can only hurt its own depositors. It guarantees nothing about the asset.\n\n### Choosing `streamWindow`\n\nBounded to `[6 hours, 30 days]` by the factory. The rule:\n\n> **`streamWindow` ≈ the keeper's interval.**\n\n- Much **shorter** than the keeper interval → yield lands in bursts. Still safe (each burst is\n  smoothed), but the displayed APY is lumpy and the vault sits at zero accrual between drops.\n- Much **longer** → each drop re-locks the previous remainder, so accrual permanently lags the real\n  yield. It all arrives eventually, just late.\n- The floor exists on purpose. `streamWindow` is the anti-sandwich defence, and the lister is not\n  necessarily a friendly party, so they don't get to set it to zero.\n\n### Running the keeper\n\n- **Just `transfer` the underlying to the vault address.** No permissions, no keeper role, nothing\n  to lose if the keeper key is compromised beyond the ability to donate. Optionally call\n  `donate(amount)` (approve + one call) for an explicit `YieldSynced` event.\n- **Keep the cadence regular and match it to `streamWindow`.** The economics above assume it.\n- **Never send to a vault that doesn't exist yet** — check `factory.vaultFor(asset)` first. Tokens\n  sent to the wrong address are gone; there is no rescue function (deliberately — a rescue function\n  on a permissionless vault is a rug vector).\n- **Anything you send is irreversible and belongs to shareholders immediately** (streamed, but\n  unrecoverable). There is no way to pull a mistaken transfer back out.\n- **Don't send the wrong token.** Only the underlying is accounted for; any other ERC-20 sent to a\n  vault is stranded forever.\n- **Wrong-size drops are self-correcting but noisy**: a huge one-off drop still streams over the\n  full window, so it can't be sandwiched, but it will show up as an absurd instantaneous APY. Have\n  the front end annualise over a period, not over the stream.\n- Monitor the `YieldSynced` and `AssetsReconciled` events. `AssetsReconciled` firing means the vault\n  holds less than it accounted for — for a well-behaved token that should never happen, and if it\n  does, the token is doing something you didn't expect.\n\n### Known edge cases\n\n- **Full exit leaves stranded assets.** If every holder redeems while a stream is still unwinding,\n  the remaining locked yield stays in the vault and accrues to whoever deposits next. Virtual shares\n  keep this from being exploitable (no revert, no runaway share price), but it is a small windfall\n  for the next depositor.\n- **`previewDeposit`/`previewRedeem` are exact** even before a `sync()`, because freshly discovered\n  yield contributes zero at the moment it's discovered. Un-synced yield does not skew quotes.\n- **No deposit cap, no pause, no fee switch, no admin.** All deliberate. It also means there is no\n  emergency stop if an asset turns out to be malicious — the only recourse is for depositors to\n  withdraw.\n"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":708,"cache_read_input_tokens":76724,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":708},"output_tokens":54,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"not_available"},"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"825dd53e-dffe-45c5-9fff-9a8ae49be4b8","uuid":"0b0de706-05e0-408f-809c-61dabf728888","timestamp":"2026-07-28T12:34:37.647Z","request_id":"req_011CdUTnvSkQ1ipE2QcPNxy3"}

{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-opus-5","id":"msg_011CdUTreBZZpnNLbzzqesGM","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"Done. `forge build` is clean and all 14 tests pass.\n\n## What's there\n\n**`src/SaveVaultFactory.sol`** — permissionless registry. `createVault(asset, streamWindow)`, no owner, no allowlist, no upgrade path, holds no funds. One canonical vault per asset; vaults are fully isolated.\n\n**`src/SaveVault.sol`** — ERC-4626 vault; the receipt token *is* the vault contract, so it's a normal transferable ERC-20.\n\n**`src/libraries/TokenMetadata.sol`** — best-effort `name()`/`symbol()` reads so permissionless listing doesn't brick on MKR-style `bytes32` metadata or tokens with no metadata at all.\n\n## One design call worth flagging\n\nThe spec says a keeper transfer \"lifts every holder's claim\" — read literally, that credits yield instantly. I didn't build it that way, because with open deposits/withdrawals and no lockup, instant crediting makes every keeper drop a public sandwich: deposit large the block before, withdraw the block after, capture yield you were never exposed to, paid for by actual holders. The keeper's txs are visible in the mempool, so it gets found.\n\nInstead, `sync()` diffs the real balance against internal accounting and releases newly discovered yield **linearly over `streamWindow`** (bounded to 6h–30d, set at listing). The keeper still just transfers tokens in — nothing changes on that side, and `sync()` is permissionless and auto-called by deposits/withdrawals. Same total yield to the same holders, just not claimable within one block. This also kills the first-depositor inflation attack for free, since a donation can no longer move the share price inside a transaction.\n\nOther hostile-asset handling, given listing is permissionless: balance-delta measurement for fee-on-transfer, `nonReentrant` + CEI for tokens with transfer hooks, SafeERC20, internal accounting rather than `balanceOf` for pricing, and virtual shares.\n\n`NOTES.md` covers the claim math and the operator checklist — token classes that don't work (rebasing), how to pick `streamWindow`, keeper rules (no rescue function is deliberate), and known edge cases."}],"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":1028,"cache_read_input_tokens":80562,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":1028},"output_tokens":2,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"not_available"},"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"825dd53e-dffe-45c5-9fff-9a8ae49be4b8","uuid":"f41d6fd9-0bdd-404e-a50a-58cfe6891a97","timestamp":"2026-07-28T12:34:54.522Z","request_id":"req_011CdUTrcB1sMTe24AaKhRi9"}
